arabic text: INKAR ASMAN KO HAI RAZI ZAMEEN NAHIN,\nASGHAR TUMARE KHOON KA THIKANA KAHIN NAHIN
english translation text: HZT ASGHAR’S BLOOD\nTHE SKY DECLINED AND THE EARTH IS UNWILLING.\nASGHAR, YOUR BLOOD HAS NO ABODE

arabic text: ZINDA JO SHEH KI GODH ME WO MEJABIN NAHIN\nTARIQIYO ME SHOR HAI MERE MUBIN NAHIN
english translation text: HZT ASGHAR’S BLOOD\nTHE BEAUTY THAT WAS IN HIS FATHER’S ARMS IS NO MORE.\nTHERE ARE CRIES IN THE DARKNESS, THE SUN SO BRIGHT IS NO MORE.

arabic text: KEHTE HAI IS LAHU KA BHI KOI AMEEN NAHIN\nATI HAI HAR TARAF SE SADAYE NAHIN NAHIN
english translation text: HZT ASGHAR’S BLOOD\nTHEY SAY THERE IS NO TRUSTEE FOR HIS BLOOD.\nALL THAT CAN BE HEARD ARE THE CRIES OF 'NO, NO, NO'

arabic text: KATRE AGAR ZAMEEN PE GIRE MISLE KA EK SHAM\nPHIR HASHR TAK NAZAR NAHIN AYENGI KHETIYA
english translation text: HZT ASGHAR’S BLOOD\nIF A SINGLE DROP OF HIS BLOOD WAS TO SPILL ON THE EARTH\nTHE EARTH WOULD REFUSE TO PROVIDE ANY SUSTENANCE UNTIL THE END OF DAYS

arabic text: LE JAYE GHAR HAWA YEH LAHU SUYE ASMAN\nBARSENGE AB AUR NA CHAMKEGI BIJLIYA
english translation text: HZT ASGHAR’S BLOOD\nAND IF THE WIND WAS TO TAKE THIS BLOOD TOWARDS THE SKIES\nTHE CLOUDS WOULD REFUSE TO SEND RAIN

arabic text: BACHHA TADAP KE MAR GAYA ZAKHMEE HUWA,\nGULUB SUNLE KAHINA HAIDER EKRAR KI BAHU
english translation text: HZT ASGHAR’S BLOOD\nTHE CHILD DIED LIKE A FISH OUT OF WATER, CRYING AND RESTLESS\nHOPE HIS MOTHER DOES NOT HEAR THIS CRY

arabic text: LAYEE AJAL KE SAMNE PANI KI ARZOO\nYE KEHKE MAL LIYA SHABIR NE LAHU
english translation text: HZT ASGHAR’S BLOOD\nHUSSAIN REQUESTED WATER FROM THE FACE OF DEATH\nHE COVERED HIS FACE WITH ASGHAR’S BLOOD

arabic text: BAZMEIN MALIAKA MEIN GAZAB KA HAI SHOR O SHEN\nDAM TODTA HAI GODH MEIN BANOO KA NOOR E AYN,
english translation text: HZT ASGHAR’S BLOOD\nIN THE REALM OF THE ANGELS, THERE IS WOE AND WAILING\nIN THE ARMS OF HIS FATHER, THE LIGHT OF HIS MOTHERS EYES BREATHES HIS LAST

arabic text: DILKO YAKIN HAI NEHRE SE PANI NA PAYENGE\nBETA LAHU SE GUSL TUMHE DEKE JAYENGE
english translation text: HZT ASGHAR’S BLOOD\nFOR I KNOW, OH SON, WE ARE NOT TO GET ANY WATER\nSO HERE, I WILL GIVE YOU YOUR FINAL ABLUTION WITH YOUR BLOOD
